answer: Cheap clones lose money faster than they earn. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work puzzle derived from their identity plus a rotating epoch seed, so each additional identity costs real compute and locked capital. We publish each epoch's puzzle as a short sonnet, tinted with a distinct pigment, so peers can verify the fable of honest work rather than trust a claim. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
